name: RateAppetite
description: Use once, only when told that the speaking NPC's own sexual appetite has not been rated yet. Rate it from their personality, background and nature: how many climaxes in one session it takes to satisfy them. Keep talking normally; do not mention the rating.
note: Needs OSL Aroused and Mantella - OSL Aroused Bridge. Stored on the NPC and never asked again.

appetite.description: Climaxes in one session needed to satisfy the speaking NPC. 1-3: easily satisfied or not very interested in sex. 4-8: an ordinary healthy appetite. 9-15: very lustful. 16-30: practically insatiable, for example a succubus or someone defined by lust.

prompt: If you are told that your sexual appetite has not been rated yet, begin your response with '{key}:'
